name: Tak Communications
old_description: TAK Broadband is a leading end-to-end U.S. fiber and broadband network contractor, offering comprehensive service solutions, from construction to drops to fulfillment, to door-to-door marketing & sales.
about:
TAK Broadband, LLC was founded in 2004 in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, initially as a door-to-door fulfillment contractor for broadband operators. The company operates as a limited liability company and has since expanded into a national fiber broadband network construction contractor.

Today the firm provides end-to-end outside plant construction, last-mile drop installation, on-premises fulfillment, and door-to-door marketing and sales for broadband networks. It maintains a workforce of more than 1,000 technicians supported by over 200 qualified construction crews and 400 bury drop crews across 139 offices in 42 states. In 2024 the company placed more than 17 million feet of drops and averages 18,000 drops per month, while handling over 1.2 million installation and trouble calls annually.

Its customers include internet service providers, multiple system operators, telecommunications carriers, electric cooperatives, tribal communities, municipalities, and private equity firms. The company also specializes in federally funded grant programs such as USDA RUS, ARPA, CPF, RDOF, ACAM, TBCP, and BEAD, offering grant writing assistance and compliance reporting.

TAK Broadband emphasizes a safety-first culture that meets OSHA, DOT, and EPA standards, and it differentiates itself through a full ecosystem that covers grant management, supply chain, engineering, construction, drops, fulfillment, project management, and marketing under one roof.
